_comment: Example registry. The interview in AGENT.md generates a real registry.json from your answers. Paths are relative to this hub directory. Fill 'remote' to allow setup on a machine where the repos are not yet present.

hub.name: BizAgent
hub._remote_comment: Private ops git remote for THIS hub (not the public framework). Installer removes public origin. Set e.g. git@host:you/bizagent-ops.git so nightly.sh push can back up registry, journals, KS, and hub tweaks. Blank = local-only.

settings._auto_update_comment: When true, nightly runs scripts/upgrade.sh (public framework → hub machinery only; never clobbers registry/cli.json/agents/company/KS/library/mail). Default false = manual-only. Operator can always run scripts/upgrade.sh or ask PTL.

dispatch._comment: Node control-plane dispatch tunables. poll_seconds honored (default 2; clamp 1–30). hub_slots and agent_slots are separate pools so hub turns do not starve product fanout (defaults: hub 1, agents = max_concurrency). max_concurrency default 8 (product-agent pool when agent_slots omitted).

enterprise._comment: Optional multi-user layer (private @bizagent/enterprise). Absent or enabled:false = pure OSS single-operator. Public control plane loads the package only when enabled===true; resolve failures soft-fail to OSS.

mcp._comment: MCP client (in-turn tools only; not the agent bus). Free/open: runtime + BYO servers. Default enabled=false → behavior unchanged. transport: stdio | http (Streamable HTTP) | sse (legacy). env/headers values are env-var *refs* (names), not secrets in git. Additive keys (allowlists, policy, audit) layer on later.

servers.name: example_remote
servers._headers_comment: Header values are env-var *names*. Set MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN='Bearer …' in ~/.bizagent/env (full header value, including Bearer prefix).

hub_agent._comment: Hub PTL launch settings. provider is an LLM key in cli.json (grok, openai, venice, openrouter…). Runtime is always bizagent-agent. cliName is a legacy alias for provider.
hub_agent.prompt: You are the hub PTL agent. Read inbox/*.md for incoming messages, process each one, then archive it. After processing all messages, send a single PushNotification with status=proactive summarizing what arrived and what you did.

models._comment: Default model for product agent launches. Per-product model field overrides this.
